gui.copycat_architect.graph_controls: Insert nodes with the top catalog or by right-clicking the graph. Right/middle drag pans; wheel zooms. Drag wires from outputs to inputs. Drag headers to move nodes. Delete removes selected wires or allowed nodes. Controls edits the same properties and connections. Enter numbers directly; group lists offer New group with a name field. Grouped assigns one material group; Separated preserves input groups. Result filters affect preview only. Ctrl+Z/Y: undo/redo; Ctrl+C/V: JSON. Escape closes menus and discards open numeric input.

gui.copycat_architect.bg_controls: Insert nodes with the top catalog or by right-clicking the graph. Right/middle drag pans; wheel zooms. Drag wires from outputs to matching inputs. Delete removes selected wires or allowed nodes. Controls edits the same properties and connections. In the Controls maps: drag room rectangles and resize their corners, or drag room areas in a storey. Extra sockets allow more rooms and levels. Enter numbers directly; material roles are text fields. Ctrl+Z/Y: undo/redo. Classic buildings remain a read-only overview of their existing settings in the graph. Origin: lowest structural layer.
